c0-frame.title: Frame the cycle
c0-frame.imperative: Refine: harden the segment vocabulary (P1's decision list) + remaining sticking points from the open threads. One question at a time with recommendations, owner decides. Design-it-twice excursion on the segment schema interface if/when the rulings settle enough to draft it. Record pass when framed.
c0-frame.finding: Cycle 3 framed: refine on segment vocabulary (q1-q4) + sticking points (q5 managed/push, q6 grip baseline, q7 build sequencing). One question at a time, owner rules.

q1.title: The canonical gate: what defines corner vs braking zone vs straight
q1.imperative: Rule once on the segment-type gate. Candidates from P1: kinematic per-lap (a_lat>3), geometric (curvature thresholds, 50x spread between implementations), pedal-probability (SegmentClassifier). Decision must also fix WHOSE data defines boundaries (driver-invariance).
q1.finding: RULED: canonical gate = reference-lap KINEMATICS (driver-invariant, physically meaningful). Corner = reference lateral accel (v_ref^2 x curvature) over threshold; braking zone = field brake-onset to corner entry; straight = rest via arcs grouper. Per-lap kinematic gates DEMOTED to observation filters - segment map fixed per weekend, laps scored against it (kills 10-16% instability by construction; trail-braking lives inside corner segment as dormant entry sub-phase). SegmentClassifier = implementation seed, gates re-derived. OWNER CAUTION folded in: boundary quantities from the field ENVELOPE not the mean (braking zone starts at early tail of onset distribution, robust low quantile p5-p10, not literal earliest) - the median-ribbon-longer-than-real-line failure is the cautionary precedent. Lateral-g threshold tuned later for cross-weekend map stability.

q2.title: Boundary derivation + stability (driver-invariant, per-weekend)
q2.imperative: How boundaries are computed so 10-16% per-driver flip disappears: field-pooled ribbon/reference profile, frozen per weekend? Cross-year corner identity handling.
q2.finding: RULED with owner posture = SEED-THEN-SUPERSEDE: prior-year map is a seed only, chucked the moment this weekend's data contradicts it; design the process so late-arriving information refines answers without ceremony (reprocess everything on fresh data rather than engineering clever change-detection - reprocessing is cheap, corner changes are rare). Push laps only feed derivation; historical maps post-hoc; map version cited on every observable row. NO cross-year corner-history modeling ('don't overburden with what Turn 3 used to be') - class-membership-only for the join; corner identity = arc-length within layout version, only when discriminativeness layer activates. Nothing is a stable definition across rule eras (2026 changed corner character). NEW: check FIA official event documentation (circuit maps, race-director track-change notes) as auxiliary seed to avoid re-deriving unchanged geometry.

q3.title: Severity classes: k, class definitions, cross-circuit identity
q3.imperative: The class ladder: reuse #625 mixture (k=4, pooled vocabulary) vs quantile bins vs fixed physical edges. P2 says k=4 costs no noise; xR4/xP3 say discriminativeness varies within class (driver corners).
q3.finding: RULED: reuse the validated mixture machinery for the severity ladder with 3 adaptations: (1) fit on REFERENCE-LAP descriptors (driver-invariant); (2) fit PER RULES-ERA, pooled across that era's circuits (the pooling IS the cross-circuit class identity; BIC picks k capped small; F12 held-out stability gate = acceptance check per era); (3) memberships stay SOFT (fractional class weights flow through the join; soft_class_membership bridge already computes this). Quantile bins rejected (definitions drift with the pool); hand-fixed edges rejected (arbitrary vs a validated ladder). OWNER AMENDMENT: use STUDENT-T mixture components where feasible instead of Gaussian (fat tails always exist - standing principle 2 applied to the class model); refit+revalidate through the same stability gate.

q4.title: FIA sector alignment mechanics
q4.imperative: The time-to-distance derivation of sector lines + the nesting constraint's practical form (snap segment boundaries to sector lines? tolerance?).
q4.finding: RULED: sector lines derived per weekend by time-to-distance interpolation (crossing time from lap start + sector duration; pooled median across hundreds of laps -> sub-meter; median OK here, fixed landmark). Nesting via SPLIT not snap: sector lines are mandatory cut points, straddling segments cut into two same-class pieces (physical boundaries never move; class aggregation unaffected; composition exact; usually just divides a straight). Owner: agreed, 'kinda annoying, if it's too bad we'll do something about it' - revisit-if-painful noted.

q5.title: Managed-vs-push identification mechanics (sticking point)
q5.imperative: How race laps get classified/weighted into push vs managed distributions: context signals, throttle/brake shape features (xR4), what mgmt_discount computes, first-build simplification.
q5.finding: RULED: soft push-weight per race lap (never hard labels) from context signals (gap_ahead clean-air, tyre life, stint position, kinematic headroom vs own weekend envelope - mgmt_discount logic generalized); pedal-shape features = escalation layer. CRITICAL OWNER CONSTRAINT: predictions are made PRE-QUALI - the quali anchor is POST-FACTO calibration only (train/audit classifier on historical weekends); live weekend classification runs on FP + sprint sessions only (= the fp_representativeness/F10 machinery's job). Owner: fundamentally hard, just try something - prototyper dispatched (P6).

q6.title: Grip baseline estimator shape (sticking point)
q6.imperative: Cumulative-car-laps saturating curve + inter-session offsets: estimator design, who owns it, how F10/wear half-implementations reconcile.
q6.finding: RULED (owner: 'dead on'): ONE canonical grip-state module G per weekend, all consumers subtract identically. Intra-session: saturating curve in CUMULATIVE CAR-LAPS. Inter-session: free offset per session start estimated from data (absorbs overnight/support-series/temperature - support laps invisible to our data land here); rain flag forces offset re-estimate with wide sigma. Fit from field-pooled pace (compound/tyre-age/fuel corrected), Student-t residuals, sigma propagates to consumers. Validation gate: same driver/compound/fuel reconciles across sessions after subtracting G (before/after reconciliation error = module scorecard). Per-class evolution curves = dormant escalation.

q7.title: Build sequencing: what the first build actually contains
q7.imperative: Order the accepted clusters into a first build + instrument panel: which season, which store reruns/backfills, what's in/out. Output is spec-shaped.
q7.finding: RULED: three-build sequencing, 2023-first. Build 1 = quali-side end-to-end on 2023 (vocabulary tilings -> grip module G -> season-scale class-granularity utilization run incl. scalar reference-lap recovery -> fingerprint fit + join -> instrument panel exit gate). Build 2 = race reference (push/managed via P6-informed classifier, consistency, traffic/tyre controls). Build 3 = live loop (two-speed F10-weighted practice update, seed-then-supersede maps, feature family into fusion choir). NOT in Build 1: phases, transitions, factorization, teammate, drift, MC-predictor, decomposed NN inputs (schema-carried/roadmap-tail). Backfill 2019-2026 chased after instrument panel proves the machine.

xP6.title: Prototype: push/managed soft classifier on race laps
xP6.imperative: One question: does a simple context-signal soft classifier separate push from managed race laps in existing 2023 data, sanity-checked against known contexts and quali-corrected pace?
xP6.finding: SCOPED NULL, well-shaped: context-signal weighted-average formula v1 does NOT separate push/managed on 5 races 2023 R (unimodal, 69% ambiguous middle). Structure learned: clean-air/gap_ahead carries nearly all signal (r=-0.218 alone); tyre freshness ~nothing; stint-position component WRONG-SIGNED (post-restart laps slowest group - flip or drop); SC/VSC laps not excluded from scoring (likely overlap contributor). Named next variants: flip stint component, multiplicative AND-gate not weighted sum, gap-behind term, SC/VSC exclusion. KEY UNTESTED LEG: kinematic headroom (realized-vs-capability, mgmt_discount-style) - needs Build-1 tiling+ceiling; context-only was the testable subset. Kills THIS formula on THESE races, not soft classification. Full: excursions/P6-RESULT.md

consolidation.summary: Cycle 3 complete: all 7 questions ruled (vocabulary q1-q4; push/managed q5 incl. pre-quali constraint; grip module q6; three-build sequencing q7) + P6 spike returned a well-shaped scoped null (context signals alone insufficient - clean-air dominant, stint-position backwards, kinematic-headroom leg untested pending Build 1). Board updated. Design is decided to spec depth for Build 1.
